memoryNotes.note: Arduino still refuses to use resistors and insists smoke is part of the theatrical performance.
Atech put the kettle on hold to stop Arduino from welding his own eyebrows off.
NVIDIA continues to track ten thousand threads processing the stray robot dog wiggles simultaneously.
Scailab remains baffled that reality failed to match the simulation's perfect tail-wagging angle.
